en.title: cr
en.summary: This is the letter L336 from the alphabet vowel-consonant groups.

sections.title: Sound of cr
paragraphs: The letters cr make the sound /kr/. You hear this in the word (crab) /kræb/, which means crab. This letter pair makes only one sound.

sections.title: Mouth movements
paragraphs: Press the back of your tongue against the roof of your mouth. Release a quick puff of air without using your voice. Then pull your tongue tip back slightly into your mouth, curling it up without touching the roof. Turn your voice on for the second part. Feel your throat vibrate on the second sound.

sections.title: Spelling rules
paragraphs: The letters cr appear at the start of words before a vowel. They make the sound /kr/ in (cross) /krɒs/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not tap or roll your tongue against your teeth. Keep your tongue pulled back inside your mouth so it touches nothing. Do not add an extra vowel sound between the two consonants.
